sections.title: Bug Fix Update
sections.description: This is a bug fix patch and contains no game balance updates. In-game replay codes and highlights from the previous patch are still available.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
sections.description: Fixed an issue with Domina's Photon Magnum beam damage not calculating correctly against armor health. Fixed a bug with Pharah's Perk Rocket Salvo that allowed users to fire more rockets than intended. Fixed an issue in 6v6 Open Queue that resulted in Stalwart Tanks not having Knockback Resistance. Fixed an issue in 6v6 Open Queue that resulted in Bruiser Tanks missing their Critical Hit Resistance.
